tasks.title: Create model 'lab-deploy'
tasks.instructions:
Create a new Juju model named `lab-deploy`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-deploy
```

Verify that the active model is `lab-deploy`:

```bash
juju switch
```

tasks.title: Deploy 'ubuntu' charm as application 'app-server'
tasks.instructions:
Deploy the `ubuntu` charm from the `latest/stable` channel with application alias `app-server`:

```bash
juju deploy ubuntu app-server --channel latest/stable
```

Verify that the application appears in `juju status`:

```bash
juju status
```

tasks.title: Deploy a second instance as 'worker-node'
tasks.instructions:
Deploy a second application from the `ubuntu` charm named `worker-node` on channel `latest/stable`:

```bash
juju deploy ubuntu worker-node --channel latest/stable
```

Verify that both applications (`app-server` and `worker-node`) exist in the model:

```bash
juju status
```
